dimensions.num_products: <int> Number of distinct products manufactured at the facility.
dimensions.num_periods: <int> Number of discrete time periods in the planning horizon.

factor_settings.capacity_utilization: <str> Level of production resource capacity tightness (low, medium, or high).
factor_settings.time_between_orders: <str> Average number of periods between consecutive production setups for each product (low, medium, or high).
factor_settings.demand_variability: <str> Degree of period-to-period fluctuation in product demand (medium or high).
factor_settings.setup_time_level: <str> Magnitude of time consumed when initiating production of a product (low or high).

parameters.demand: <list[list[int]], shape [num_products][num_periods]> Quantity of each product that must be delivered in each period.
parameters.holding_cost: <list[list[float]], shape [num_products][num_periods]> Per-unit cost of carrying one unit of each product in inventory at the end of each period.
parameters.setup_cost: <list[list[float]], shape [num_products][num_periods]> Fixed cost incurred whenever production of each product is initiated in each period.
parameters.variable_production_cost: <list[list[float]], shape [num_products][num_periods]> Per-unit cost of producing each product in each period.
parameters.variable_production_time: <list[list[float]], shape [num_products][num_periods]> Time consumed on the shared resource to produce one unit of each product in each period.
parameters.setup_time: <list[list[float]], shape [num_products][num_periods]> Time consumed on the shared resource when initiating production of each product in each period.
parameters.capacity: <list[int], length num_periods> Total available time on the shared production resource in each period.
parameters.initial_inventory_cost: <list[float], length num_products> Per-unit penalty cost for each product's initial inventory available at the start of the first period.
